registry.description: Desire is the reaching of the inner person toward what it wants — the movement of the will and appetite toward something not yet possessed. The Hebrew and Greek vocabulary spans a vast range: the desire that is pure longing, the desire that is appetite, the desire that is wish, and the desire that is the settled inclination of the heart. God himself is described using desire vocabulary — he desires, chooses, longs for his people. Desire is not inherently sinful; it is the motive force of the inner life, capable of being rightly or wrongly ordered.
